title: 生气的时候
subtitle: 心里的小火山要喷发了，怎么办？
character: wearing a navy t-shirt with a yellow star, grey shorts and red sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, thick expressive acrylic brush strokes, bold primary colors, textured paper, simple shapes
facts: 像闻花一样吸气，像吹蜡烛一样吐气
等心里的小火山变小再说话
「我很生气，因为……」，不打人、不推人

pages.zh:
我用积木搭了一座城堡，
高高的，
比我的头还要高！
pages.scene: The little boy kneels on a colorful rug next to a tall wooden block castle that is taller than his head, looking proud.

pages.zh:
表弟跑过来，
一不小心——
哗啦！
城堡倒了。
pages.scene: A younger toddler cousin with curly brown hair in a red t-shirt bumps into a tall tower of wooden blocks by accident, and the blocks tumble down across the rug.

pages.zh:
我的脸一下子变得好热，
拳头攥得紧紧的。
心里像有一座小火山，
快要喷发了！
pages.scene: The little boy stands beside the fallen blocks with a red angry face and tightly clenched fists, and a small red cartoon volcano puffing smoke is drawn beside him like a picture of his feelings.

pages.zh:
我好想推他，好想大声喊。
可是，推人会让别人受伤。
我停住了。
pages.scene: The little boy stands with his arms stiff at his sides and his fists clenched, stopping himself, lips pressed together, eyes squeezed shut.

pages.zh:
我想起了妈妈教我的魔法——
「深呼吸」。
像闻一朵花一样，
慢慢地吸气……
pages.scene: The little boy holds a small flower up to his nose with his eyes closed, slowly breathing in, his face softening.

pages.zh:
再像吹蜡烛一样，
慢慢地吐气……
呼——
pages.scene: The little boy puffs out his cheeks and blows out gently as if blowing out birthday candles, calm and focused.

pages.zh:
一、二、三、四、五。
心里的小火山，
慢慢地变小了。
pages.scene: The little boy sits on the rug counting on his fingers with a calm face, and the little cartoon volcano beside him has become tiny and quiet.

pages.zh:
我对表弟说：
「我很生气，
因为你把我的城堡弄倒了。」
pages.scene: The little boy sits facing his younger curly-haired cousin on the rug and talks to him calmly, the fallen blocks between them.

pages.zh:
表弟小声地说：
「对不起。」
他把一块积木递给我。
pages.scene: The younger toddler cousin with curly brown hair holds out a wooden block with both hands, looking sorry and hopeful, on a colorful rug.

pages.zh:
我们一起重新搭城堡。
这一次，比上次还要高！
生气的时候，
我知道该怎么办了。
pages.scene: The little boy and his younger curly-haired cousin build a new tall wooden block castle together on the rug, both happy and proud.
